verdict.rationale: Only a vague marketing line ('Collaborate and iterate quickly with your team') touches on team workflows, with no documentation of YAML/text-diffable scene formats, smart-merge tooling, or Unity's dedicated version-control product for scenes/prefabs. Community evidence focuses on pricing/licensing disputes and doesn't address merge-friendliness of the format itself. Missing for 10: evidence of diffable/mergeable scene or prefab formats, details on built-in collaboration/version-control product (e.g., Unity Version Control), and independent confirmation that multi-person teams can work without binary merge conflicts.
